name: Composition
description: Indicates that an element consists of one or more other concepts.
notation: Line with filled diamond at the composite end

name: Aggregation
description: Indicates that an element combines one or more other concepts.
notation: Line with open diamond at the aggregate end

name: Assignment
description: Expresses the allocation of responsibility, performance of behaviour, storage, or execution.
notation: Line with filled circle and arrow

name: Realisation
description: Indicates that an entity plays a critical role in the creation, achievement, sustenance, or operation of a more abstract entity.

name: Serving
description: Models that an element provides its functionality to another element.

name: Access
description: Models the ability of behaviour and active structure elements to observe or act upon passive structure elements.

name: Influence
description: Models that an element affects the implementation or achievement of some motivation element.
notation: Dashed line with open arrowhead and label

name: Triggering
description: Describes a temporal or causal relationship between elements.

name: Flow
description: Describes the exchange or transfer of, for example, information or value between processes, function, interactions, and events.

name: Specialisation
description: Indicates that an element is a particular kind of another element.
